articles.headline: LASG approves feasibility study, selects preferred site for proposed Lekki–Epe airport
articles.body: The Lagos State Government has approved a comprehensive feasibility study and preliminary designs for a proposed new airport on the Lekki-Epe corridor. The study will assess passenger demand, financing options and environmental impact. No construction contract has been awarded, and no construction timeline has been announced. A decision on whether to proceed will follow completion of the study, expected in 2027.
